description: This file defines the PredicateVisitor interface for implementing the visitor pattern to traverse an Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) related to predicate nodes in a query or expression language. It declares visit methods for various node types such as RootNode, LogicalNode, SingleComparisonNode, MultiComparisonNode, ExistsNode, and a general Node class.

classes.name: PredicateVisitor
classes.description: Interface for the visitor pattern to traverse through the AST of predicate nodes.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Accepts a specific type of node, implementing the visitor pattern to perform operations on the node. There are separate visit methods for each node type such as RootNode, LogicalNode, SingleComparisonNode, MultiComparisonNode, ExistsNode, and a general Node.
